budget_change.consumer: Current registered owner providers, user-facing entries and their regression tests
budget_change.reason: Current Git owner identity, private-companion discovery and read-error categorization require the two files added since the prior baseline. No additional Git platform or snapshot is introduced. Byte headroom is bounded by the measured UTF-8 LF-to-CRLF checkout expansion plus 1 KiB, not a feature allowance; the general eight-percent ceiling is unchanged.
budget_change.exit_condition: Recompute against measured retained consumers after removals or when this exact ceiling is exhausted; do not retain obsolete behavior or raise limits without evidence.
